{{Quote|That boy you're seeking&hellip;and his droid&hellip;held out hope of something better, Vader. A time, a life, when even someone like me might not be a freak.|Beilert Valance, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 29">[[Star Wars (1977) 29|''Star Wars'' (1977) 29]]</ref>}}
A '''duel''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] between the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]], as Vader was seeking the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] deserter [[Tyler Lucian]] in their effort to discover the name of the [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|pilot]] who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], and Valance was attempting to prevent Vader from finding him. The duel ended when Valance was thrown into Centares' corrosive lakes, and Lucian committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] rather than be captured.

==Behind the scenes==
The death of Valance depicted in Star Wars (1977) 29 was retconned by the Star Wars (1977) 108 comic. In 108, Valance claims he entered into a coma while submerged into the corrosive lakes of Centares.
